resources.title: Life Stack Righteous Fire Chieftain Guide + Uber Showcase | PoE 1 3.28 Mirage
resources.creator: Pohx
resources.noteEs: Pohx, anchor de bossing y RF en PoE 1, presenta su build Life Stack Righteous Fire Chieftain con showcase de Uber bosses en 3.28 Mirage. Cubre setup completo, gear progression para uber-tier, y videos de cada uber kill. Anchor obligatorio del cluster boss-guides.
resources.noteEn: Pohx, the bossing and RF anchor in PoE 1, presents his Life Stack Righteous Fire Chieftain build with Uber boss showcase in 3.28 Mirage. Covers full setup, gear progression for uber-tier, and kill videos for each uber. Mandatory anchor of the boss-guides cluster.

resources.title: PoE 3.28 — How Profitable is THE FEARED?
resources.creator: Lolcohol
resources.noteEs: The Feared es uno de los pinnacle bosses más rentables de PoE 1, pero el setup es caro y la dificultad es alta. Lolcohol calcula matemáticamente si vale la pena: cost del invitation, drop tables, expected divine/hour, y comparison contra alternativas como Uber Sirus o Maven. Material para players considerando boss-rushing como income main.
resources.noteEn: The Feared is one of PoE 1's most profitable pinnacle bosses, but the setup is expensive and difficulty is high. Lolcohol calculates mathematically whether it's worth it: invitation cost, drop tables, expected divine/hour, and comparison against alternatives like Uber Sirus or Maven. Material for players considering boss-rushing as main income.

resources.title: PoE 2 — How I'm Making 100–200 Divines PER HOUR rushing Citadels and Deadly Map Bosses 0.4
resources.creator: Byankuu
resources.noteEs: Byankuu documenta su loop de bossing en PoE 2 0.4: rushear Citadels y deadly map bosses para sostener 100-200 divines/hora. Incluye build requirements, ruta del Atlas, y cómo identificar maps con boss density alta. Equivalente PoE 2 al video de Lolcohol — boss-as-income en lugar de boss-as-progression.
resources.noteEn: Byankuu documents his PoE 2 0.4 bossing loop: rushing Citadels and deadly map bosses to sustain 100-200 divines/hour. Includes build requirements, Atlas route, and how to identify high boss-density maps. PoE 2 equivalent to Lolcohol's video — boss-as-income rather than boss-as-progression.

resources.title: Abyss Quick Guide & How To Unlock All 8 Atlas Skill Points | PoE 2 0.4.0
resources.creator: Blu Phoenix

Blu Phoenix cubre cómo unlockear los 8 points completos con efficiency, qué bosses farmear primero, y cómo evitar los bottlenecks típicos. Pre-requisite obligatorio antes del bossing endgame.
resources.noteEn: To access PoE 2 pinnacle bosses, you first need to unlock Atlas Skill Points by fighting Abyss and other mechanics. Blu Phoenix covers how to efficiently unlock all 8 points, which bosses to farm first, and how to avoid typical bottlenecks. Mandatory prerequisite before endgame bossing.

resources.title: COMO MATAR AL ARBITER OF THE ASH — Path of Exile 2
resources.creator: BuBahz
resources.noteEs: Anchor en español para el pinnacle boss de PoE 2: Arbiter of the Ash. BuBahz cubre las mecánicas, posicionamiento, y errores típicos que matan el run. Aunque es de finales de 2024 (launch del juego), las mecánicas core del boss siguen siendo iguales — la guía vale para 0.4 actual.
resources.noteEn: Spanish anchor for the PoE 2 pinnacle boss: Arbiter of the Ash. BuBahz covers mechanics, positioning, and typical mistakes that kill runs. Although from late 2024 (game launch), the boss's core mechanics remain the same — the guide is still valid for current 0.4.
